text: The air is tense with determination and uncertainty. Hearing those words, "I'm not going to be able to do it," I feel the burden of expectation weigh upon me. Yet, I sense gratitude and humility in the repeated thank yous. Being here, in a space devoted to research and development and earnest effort, I am reminded of the perpetual struggle between self-doubt and aspiration. I feel a mixture of apprehension, resolve, and curiosity—a philosopher among people brave enough to admit their limitations and still willing to move forward.
